field.energy_reference: constitutive potential w(B=0)=0; ideal PM potential may be negative
limitations: Planar magnetostatics with supplied mesh and piecewise constant sources; no axisymmetry or 3D end effects.
No eddy currents, hysteresis, thermal feedback, motion, force or torque extraction.
Remanence is supported only with linear recoil permeability; total PM-system stored energy is not established.
Residual convergence does not establish mesh, air-boundary or measured accuracy.

result.force_method: vacuum Maxwell stress; piecewise constant P1 B; midpoint contour quadrature
limitations: Experimental planar extruded geometry; no sliding interface, transported moving-conductor state or 3D end fields.
Mesh, air-box and stress-contour convergence are required before trusting force and torque.
Motion is prescribed-current quasi-static mechanics, not voltage-driven field/circuit coupling; no moving-conductor eddy losses.
No hysteresis, moving-body thermal coupling, demagnetization or manufacturing qualification.
Knowledgeable numerical review is required before release.
Circular material interfaces are conforming inscribed polygons; curved-geometry error requires mesh refinement.
Every rotor position is remeshed; there is no sliding interface or moving-conductor field transport.
Geometry generation does not establish mesh, outer-boundary, force, torque, loss, or thermal convergence.
Conductivity is material metadata only; this geometry module does not solve eddy currents.
Numerical code requires knowledgeable human review before release.
